command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1 OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
export OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
# No PATH export: aarchsci env images already have their python first.
# The checks live in ksp.sh (staged, pinned here) to keep this inside EC2's 16 KiB user data.
printf '66a7e3b695fe91afd722daf05246a6dc48e44b78b3b7e2d9fd7f945ed5767460  ex2.py\n52182d54284df339fe2623d5a29c7677ea65cc29bfd3264ad2a3e28b090a9057  ksp.sh\n' > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
. ./ksp.sh
